review: The primary reader inspected the whole scan and both supplied halves before the witnesses, then seven broad crops at 4–8×, two upright margin crops, twenty-seven focused crops at 7–14× and nine supplementary crops at 10–12×. An earlier truncated response did not display the first requested focused images; all twenty-seven were subsequently displayed in small batches and read. The two margins and three supplementary margin details were rotated clockwise 90 degrees, assoc. clockwise 1 degree and the provient insertion clockwise 3 degrees. Every agreed word and mathematical sign was compared with the ink; all C doubts, H differences, cancellations, insertions and diagram endpoints were enlarged. The final inventory was checked top to bottom, including insertion guides, the looped bracket, the extra curve along a margin arrow and its detached mark. No OCR, context or delegated manuscript reading was used.
